PluginData.Author: DrummDrumm
PluginData.Tooltip: Dock camera, Docking Assist screens and docking guidance for any connector, with an API for other plugins and mods.
PluginData.Description:
Protogen Systems Docking Solutions helps you dock: a full-screen dock camera on your connector's face with guidance (crosshair, target brackets, approach corridor, range, closing speed, offset, alignment and the next step), and the "DOCK - Docking Assist" LCD script (any LCD, cockpit or seat screen) with a drawn approach view, tunnel, scope and gauges.
Optional while docking: a picture-in-picture window of the dock camera that can pop up near a dock, steering from the camera (W flies the way it looks), and a docking dampener that limits the speed your keys ask for. All of it is set up in the settings window (Pulsar plugin list).
Works with any connector block, vanilla or modded: one with [Dock] in its name is picked first, one with [NoDock] is never used. Chat: /dock on | off | next | target | offset | map | theme. Toolbar actions on every cockpit.
Other plugins and mods can read the docking figures, the dock camera's spot and the Docking Assist sprites through the mod message API (Api/DockingSolutionsApi.cs). Client-side only: nothing extra is sent to the server. Steering from the camera and the dampener only change the move and turn input your seat already sends.
